CUDA.scope: Global CUDA free is shared, not an owned-process delta; allocator counters omit context/driver allocations. Metrics may perturb timing or synchronize. Never add free bytes to host MemAvailable.

details.scope: Own PyTorch caching allocator only. Not a context/driver/cuBLAS/physical UMA or cgroup hard cap. Never enlarged on failure.

memory.scope: Sequential non-atomic own-process/own-cgroup snapshot; page cache release and disk IO bytes are not inferred.

snapshot_scope: Sequential non-atomic own process/cgroup, host and global CUDA samples; owner admission remains external.
